conventions: A bare nominal standing in apposition to a preceding בְּ phrase and rendered with a supplied preposition of its own — הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ → 'in his holy mountain' (48.1), יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן → 'on the sides of the north' (48.2) — takes that supplied word on the noun under rule 33. It is not read as a distributed repetition of the earlier written בְּ under rules 25/33: those sentences govern a member coordinated under one written preposition, and an appositive is not coordinated. The alternative was considered in 48.1 and rejected for both verses.
report: Read all 15 verses end to end against the 17-lemma candidate table. Every multi-treatment bucket is a difference the source or the ASV licenses, not a split: הוּא Sp3fs 'it' (object suffix, 48.8) vs 'her' (possessive on a noun, 48.13); אֱלֹהִים construct 'of God' as rectum (48.1, 48.8) vs 'is God' as verbless-clause predicate carrying the copula (48.14); לְ 'for'/'to' read off the ASV; עוֹלָם takes 'for ever' only where no עַד stands (48.14, rule 33) and bare 'ever' where עַד takes the 'for' (48.8, rule 11); הַר 'mount' before Zion vs 'in mountain' as a bare appositional locative (48.1, rule 33), matching יַרְכְּתֵי → 'on the sides' in 48.2.

Checked the constructions the table is blind to: both supplied object pronouns ('it' in 48.5 and 48.13) are `added` under rule 44; every phrasal particle (passed by, hasted away, Walk about, go round about) stays with its verb; both vocatives take 'O'; the copula goes to the adjective (48.1, 48.2), to the prepositional predicate (48.10 עַל, rule 49), to the nominal predicate (48.14), and to the sole overt anchor שֵׁם where the predicate is elided (48.10, rule 20). All consistent.

The one noncompositional unit (48.13 שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְ → 'Mark ye well') is defensible on the pattern of rule 40's רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ → 'it displease'; the competing reading (suffix and לְ unrepresented outside a two-morpheme fusion) is named in its note and does not recur in the chapter. 48.6's 'as of' on כְּ likewise names its alternative. Neither is a cross-verse matter and neither was changed.
